mainEntity.name: Do you inspect pump and pressure-distribution systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The state's inspection rule covers the pump tank, control panel, alarm and pump operation, and I evaluate all of it. If the power is off at a vacant house, the report says the pump system couldn't be fully evaluated, so have the utilities on.

mainEntity.name: Will frozen ground or snow stop the inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can slow it down. Frozen ground makes digging harder and snow hides the drain field. Tell me the deadline and we'll plan around the weather; I'd rather reschedule a day than report a system I couldn't actually see.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve Blowing Rock, Valle Crucis and Deep Gap?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the High Country around Boone is part of my service area. Steep access and long gravel drives are normal here; just let me know what to expect.
